propositions: A parent removed in Jira is never cleared from the local ticket because the snapshot omits absent parent fields and the differ refuses to emit parent_id=None
The two-layer suppression collapses 'Jira observed no parent' with 'parent key not yet resolvable' into a single None state, blocking safe clear detection
The managed_refs gate alone cannot prove the peer ever had the parent; it only proves rebar set it locally, leaving data loss on de-parenting if peer evidence is absent
Clearing a parent requires positive evidence from a prior observation that the peer once carried it; absence of data must never trigger a destructive write
The inbound-clear path must be gated on per-binding peer-parent history advanced only when a parent observation is confirmed, not when reads fail or pages truncate
